observations.name: open and attach
observations.detail: The titlebar Terminal action opens a Terminal tab backed by a running server PTY at the active workspace cwd.

observations.name: text input
observations.detail: Physical keyboard input writes pwd into the Native command field.

observations.name: write and streamed output
observations.detail: A physical Run click sends pwd through terminal.write; the attach stream renders /Users/bytedance/github/background-only and the persisted isolated PTY history contains the same output.

observations.name: close and delete history
observations.detail: A physical tab-close click removes the Terminal surface and terminal.close(deleteHistory:true) removes the isolated history file.

observations.name: Enter submit
observations.detail: Physical Return did not emit bindconfirm in Lynxtron 0.0.16; the visible Run action remains the verified submission path.
